events.diff:
import zlib
+import os
 import numpy as np
@@
 def weight_for(case: Case, out_shape, seed_salt="w") -> np.ndarray:
   rng = np.random.default_rng(zlib.crc32((case.id + seed_salt).encode()))
   return np.asarray(rng.random(out_shape, dtype=np.float32) + 0.25, dtype=np.float32)  # 0-d safe; away from 0 so grads don't vanish
+
+def load_extra_cases(path=None):
+  path = path or os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "extra_cases.txt")
+  if not os.path.exists(path): return []
+  out = []
+  for line in open(path):
+    line = line.strip()
+    if not line or line.startswith("#"): continue
+    cid, target, grad, body = (p.strip() for p in line.split("|", 3))
+    fn = eval("lambda *a: " + body)
+    out.append(Case(cid, fn, int(grad) == 1, target))
+  return out
+
+CASES += load_extra_cases()

+# id | target | grad(0/1) | lambda body over inputs a[0], a[1], ...
+t6_extra_pad_then_flip | T6 | 1 | a[0].pad((1,1)).flip(0)
+t6_extra_stride_gather | T6 | 1 | a[0][::2].sum()
+t7_extra_double_perm | T7 | 1 | a[0].permute(1,0).permute(1,0)
